source.identityVerification: Local HEAD and HEAD^{tree} were checked immediately before capture and while writing this manifest. The builder verified the staged source tree against the preserved remote source tree.

prerequisitesReportedByBuilder: Token and icon packages built before the final Storybook and React builds.
build.timingNote: Builds completed from the identical staged tree before creation of the source commit object. No source edits occurred after staging; the tree identity is the provenance link to the named commit.
build.artifactTreeHashDefinition: SHA-256 of UTF-8 lines <file sha256><two spaces><relative POSIX path><newline>, sorted lexicographically by relative path across every file in storybook-static.
build.scope: These images render the built Storybook implementation with synthetic fixtures; they are not evidence of consumer application adoption or a packed-package rendering.

capture.orchestration: A Python static server and the Node browser-check process were child processes of the same launcher invocation so they shared the available local network namespace. The server was terminated when the browser suite exited.
capture.presentationChanges: None. Final images use the built source without injected CSS or application changes. The capture helper clears hover/focus and dismisses transient popovers before taking each image.
capture.data: Synthetic observations and caller-supplied candidate relationships from the committed InvestigationLedger fixture.
